It stays near baseline for intensifiers ('very', 'extremely', 'quite'), morphological comparatives ('bigger', 'richer'), specified or classifying counts ('three', 'several', 'multiple', 'another', and 'more' after a numeral such as 'one more', 'two more'), the nouns 'amount'/'quantity', and strings that only contain 'more'/'less' ('moreover', 'anymore', 'useless').
